designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system is tailored specifically for operational commerce teams, fulfillment coordinators, and inventory specialists operating in Thailand. Its visual and structural tone is grounded in pure operational clarity, utility, and density, eschewing extraneous ornamentation or decorative stock imagery in favor of high-information-density workflows, precise data visualization, and fast transaction handling.

The style fuses **Corporate / Modern** discipline with clean, flat data architecture:
- **Tone:** Authoritative, responsive, reliable, calm, and frictionless.
- **Visual Tenet:** White planar surfaces stacked deliberately against an ultra-soft cool-tinted canvas (`#f6f8fc`), defined by delicate 1px structural dividing lines rather than exaggerated shadows.
- **Dual-Language First:** Tailored to gracefully balance English technical terminology with natural Thai typography, accounting for Thai ascenders, descenders, and tonal marks without baseline breakage or line-height clipping.

## Layout & Spacing

The workspace leverages a persistent application shell calibrated for wide-screen desktop monitors, laptop screens, and tablet point-of-sale stations.

### Layout Topology
- **App Shell Structure:** A fixed persistent 256px sidebar anchored to the left viewport boundary, spanning 100vh.
- **Contextual Header:** Compact 56px sticky top header containing global search, the language switcher (`ไทย` / `English`), notification alerts, and the prominent sample environment chip (`ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง`).
- **Main Operational Canvas:** Fills the remainder of the viewport with a maximum content container width of `1240px`, centered within the canvas on ultra-wide screens.
- **Responsive Handling:**
  - **Desktop (≥ 1280px):** 256px fixed sidebar, full 12-column content grid, maximum width 1240px.
  - **Tablet (768px – 1279px):** Sidebar collapses to an icon rail (68px) or drawer; container margins adjust to `margin-sm` (1rem).
  - **Mobile (< 768px):** Off-canvas drawer navigation; forms and metric cards fold into a 1-column stack.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy relies on clean surface layering rather than complex drop shadows:

- **Surface Levels:** 
  - Level 0 (Base Canvas): `#f6f8fc`
  - Level 1 (Card & Section Containers): `#ffffff` with a crisp `1px solid #e1e7f0` border.
  - Level 2 (Floating Popovers, Dropdowns, Datepickers): `#ffffff` with `border: 1px solid #e1e7f0` and an ambient subtle shadow: `0 8px 24px -4px rgba(23, 36, 59, 0.08)`.
  - Level 3 (Modals & Slide-out Panels): Supported by a semi-translucent backdrop (`rgba(23, 36, 59, 0.45)`).
- **Zero-Shadow Default:** Regular static cards, metrics, and data tables avoid drop shadows entirely. Clean `#e1e7f0` borders provide clear, predictable visual boundaries that keep the operational canvas uncluttered.

## Components

### 1. Form Inputs & Control Bar
- **Standard Control Height:** All default text inputs, select dropdowns, search bars, and primary buttons are fixed at `40px` height.
- **Input Styling:** Background `#ffffff`, border `1px solid #e1e7f0`, border-radius `8px`, typography `body-default` (`14px`), text `#17243b`, placeholder `#7e8d9f`.
- **Focus State:** Border changes to `#365cf5` with an outer focus ring: `0 0 0 3px #edf2fe`.

### 2. Buttons
- **Primary:** Background `#365cf5`, text `#ffffff`, border `none`, border-radius `8px`, height `40px`, padding `0 16px`, font `Inter` 14px 600. Hover: `#2b4ed4`. Active: `#213fb3`.
- **Secondary / Ghost:** Background `#ffffff`, border `1px solid #e1e7f0`, text `#17243b`. Hover: `#f6f8fc` with border `#d8e0eb`.
- **Primary Light / Subdued:** Background `#edf2fe`, text `#365cf5`, border `none`. Hover: `#dce6fd`.

### 3. Operational Badges & Status Chips
Badges use `micro-tag` (12px, weight 500), horizontal padding `8px`, vertical padding `2px`, height `22px`, and a pill-shaped radius (`9999px`):
- **Success (e.g., จัดส่งสำเร็จ / Fulfilled):** Background `#eaf5ef`, border `1px solid #a8dcc0`, text `#157347`.
- **Warning (e.g., รอชำระเงิน / Pending Payment):** Background `#fdf8e8`, border `1px solid #f0dc91`, text `#b08900`.
- **Error (e.g., ยกเลิกแล้ว / Cancelled):** Background `#fbecee`, border `1px solid #f4b4ba`, text `#c2333f`.
- **Neutral (e.g., แบบร่าง / Draft):** Background `#f1f4f9`, border `1px solid #d8e0eb`, text `#334155`.

### 4. Language Switcher & Environment Indicator
- **Language Switcher:** A segmented 32px pill switch in the header (`ไทย` | `English`). Active language pill uses `#ffffff` with subtle border `#e1e7f0` and `#17243b` text; inactive segment uses transparent background with `#7e8d9f` text.
- **Environment Indicator:** The `ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง` (Sample Data) chip is pinned in the contextual header. Styled with background `#fdf8e8`, border `1px solid #f0dc91`, and text `#b08900`, pairing a 6px warning dot to alert staff that non-production data is active.

### 5. Cards & Tables
- **Cards:** Background `#ffffff`, border `1px solid #e1e7f0`, border-radius `12px`, padding `20px` (or `24px` for high-level metrics).
- **Card Headers:** `title-card` (`16px`, semibold, `#17243b`), paired with an optional top-right action or badge.
- **Data Tables:** Outer border `1px solid #e1e7f0`, header row background `#f6f8fc`, header cell text `13px` medium `#52627a`, row divider `1px solid #e1e7f0`, cell height `48px`, row hover background `#f9fafc`.

## Colors

The palette delivers strict functional differentiation while maintaining visual comfort over long monitoring and operations shifts.

### Surfaces & Grayscale
- **Canvas / App Background:** `#f6f8fc` (Cool tinted backdrop providing contrast for cards)
- **Card & Surface Background:** `#ffffff` (Crisp white work surfaces)
- **Border Structural Base:** `#e1e7f0` (1px crisp dividing boundary)
- **Primary Ink Text:** `#17243b` (High-contrast primary readable content)
- **Secondary Ink Text:** `#52627a` (Descriptive labels, secondary headers, meta values)
- **Muted Ink Text:** `#7e8d9f` (Placeholders, inactive tabs, auxiliary cues)

### Interactive Brand Core
- **Primary Action:** `#365cf5`
- **Primary Action Hover:** `#2b4ed4`
- **Primary Action Light / Tint:** `#edf2fe`

### Semantic & Status Badging (Explicit Pairs)
- **Success:** Solid ink `#157347` | Background `#eaf5ef` | Border `#a8dcc0`
- **Warning:** Solid ink `#b08900` | Background `#fdf8e8` | Border `#f0dc91`
- **Error / Critical:** Solid ink `#c2333f` | Background `#fbecee` | Border `#f4b4ba`
- **Neutral / Draft Badge:** Solid ink `#334155` | Background `#f1f4f9` | Border `#d8e0eb`

Typography prioritizes bilingual legibility. `Noto Sans` (with comprehensive Noto Sans Thai glyph fallback) handles top-level headings and localized page anchors, while `Inter` handles operational tables, data values, code-like identifiers, and inputs.

- **Vertical Metric Rules:** Thai vowels and tonal marks (วรรณยุกต์) require generous line-height ratios. No element may have a `lineHeight` below 1.35x its font size to prevent upper and lower diacritic clipping.
- **Numbers & Currencies:** Figures, SKU numbers, Thai Baht quantities (`฿`), and dates must align with tabular or monospace figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) within data tables and financial summaries.

The geometric framework balances sturdy containment for cards with ergonomic tactile rounding for interactives:

- **Cards & Data Modules:** Explicitly set to `12px` (`0.75rem`) corner radius. This gives operational blocks a clear, friendly outline while fitting within grid constraints.
- **Interactive Controls (Inputs, Selects, Buttons, Tabs):** Explicitly set to `8px` (`0.5rem`) corner radius.

The style fuses **Corporate / Modern** discipline with clean, flat data architecture:
- **Tone:** Authoritative, responsive, reliable, calm, and frictionless.
- **Visual Tenet:** White planar surfaces stacked deliberately against an ultra-soft cool-tinted canvas (`#f6f8fc`), defined by delicate 1px structural dividing lines rather than exaggerated shadows.
- **Dual-Language First:** Tailored to gracefully balance English technical terminology with natural Thai typography, accounting for Thai ascenders, descenders, and tonal marks without baseline breakage or line-height clipping.

## Colors

The palette delivers strict functional differentiation while maintaining visual comfort over long monitoring and operations shifts.

### Surfaces & Grayscale
- **Canvas / App Background:** `#f6f8fc` (Cool tinted backdrop providing contrast for cards)
- **Card & Surface Background:** `#ffffff` (Crisp white work surfaces)
- **Border Structural Base:** `#e1e7f0` (1px crisp dividing boundary)
- **Primary Ink Text:** `#17243b` (High-contrast primary readable content)
- **Secondary Ink Text:** `#52627a` (Descriptive labels, secondary headers, meta values)
- **Muted Ink Text:** `#7e8d9f` (Placeholders, inactive tabs, auxiliary cues)

### Interactive Brand Core
- **Primary Action:** `#365cf5`
- **Primary Action Hover:** `#2b4ed4`
- **Primary Action Light / Tint:** `#edf2fe`

### Semantic & Status Badging (Explicit Pairs)
- **Success:** Solid ink `#157347` | Background `#eaf5ef` | Border `#a8dcc0`
- **Warning:** Solid ink `#b08900` | Background `#fdf8e8` | Border `#f0dc91`
- **Error / Critical:** Solid ink `#c2333f` | Background `#fbecee` | Border `#f4b4ba`
- **Neutral / Draft Badge:** Solid ink `#334155` | Background `#f1f4f9` | Border `#d8e0eb`

## Typography

Typography prioritizes bilingual legibility. `Noto Sans` (with comprehensive Noto Sans Thai glyph fallback) handles top-level headings and localized page anchors, while `Inter` handles operational tables, data values, code-like identifiers, and inputs.

- **Vertical Metric Rules:** Thai vowels and tonal marks (วรรณยุกต์) require generous line-height ratios. No element may have a `lineHeight` below 1.35x its font size to prevent upper and lower diacritic clipping.
- **Numbers & Currencies:** Figures, SKU numbers, Thai Baht quantities (`฿`), and dates must align with tabular or monospace figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) within data tables and financial summaries.

## Layout & Spacing

The workspace leverages a persistent application shell calibrated for wide-screen desktop monitors, laptop screens, and tablet point-of-sale stations.

### Layout Topology
- **App Shell Structure:** A fixed persistent 256px sidebar anchored to the left viewport boundary, spanning 100vh.
- **Contextual Header:** Compact 56px sticky top header containing global search, the language switcher (`ไทย` / `English`), notification alerts, and the prominent sample environment chip (`ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง`).
- **Main Operational Canvas:** Fills the remainder of the viewport with a maximum content container width of `1240px`, centered within the canvas on ultra-wide screens.
- **Responsive Handling:**
  - **Desktop (≥ 1280px):** 256px fixed sidebar, full 12-column content grid, maximum width 1240px.
  - **Tablet (768px – 1279px):** Sidebar collapses to an icon rail (68px) or drawer; container margins adjust to `margin-sm` (1rem).
  - **Mobile (< 768px):** Off-canvas drawer navigation; forms and metric cards fold into a 1-column stack.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy relies on clean surface layering rather than complex drop shadows:

- **Surface Levels:** 
  - Level 0 (Base Canvas): `#f6f8fc`
  - Level 1 (Card & Section Containers): `#ffffff` with a crisp `1px solid #e1e7f0` border.
  - Level 2 (Floating Popovers, Dropdowns, Datepickers): `#ffffff` with `border: 1px solid #e1e7f0` and an ambient subtle shadow: `0 8px 24px -4px rgba(23, 36, 59, 0.08)`.
  - Level 3 (Modals & Slide-out Panels): Supported by a semi-translucent backdrop (`rgba(23, 36, 59, 0.45)`).
- **Zero-Shadow Default:** Regular static cards, metrics, and data tables avoid drop shadows entirely. Clean `#e1e7f0` borders provide clear, predictable visual boundaries that keep the operational canvas uncluttered.

## Shapes

The geometric framework balances sturdy containment for cards with ergonomic tactile rounding for interactives:

- **Cards & Data Modules:** Explicitly set to `12px` (`0.75rem`) corner radius. This gives operational blocks a clear, friendly outline while fitting within grid constraints.
- **Interactive Controls (Inputs, Selects, Buttons, Tabs):** Explicitly set to `8px` (`0.5rem`) corner radius.
- **Status Badges & Pill Chips:** Full circular capsule radius (`9999px`) to immediately distinguish informative tags from interactive rectangular buttons.

## Components

### 1. Form Inputs & Control Bar
- **Standard Control Height:** All default text inputs, select dropdowns, search bars, and primary buttons are fixed at `40px` height.
- **Input Styling:** Background `#ffffff`, border `1px solid #e1e7f0`, border-radius `8px`, typography `body-default` (`14px`), text `#17243b`, placeholder `#7e8d9f`.
- **Focus State:** Border changes to `#365cf5` with an outer focus ring: `0 0 0 3px #edf2fe`.

### 2. Buttons
- **Primary:** Background `#365cf5`, text `#ffffff`, border `none`, border-radius `8px`, height `40px`, padding `0 16px`, font `Inter` 14px 600. Hover: `#2b4ed4`. Active: `#213fb3`.
- **Secondary / Ghost:** Background `#ffffff`, border `1px solid #e1e7f0`, text `#17243b`. Hover: `#f6f8fc` with border `#d8e0eb`.
- **Primary Light / Subdued:** Background `#edf2fe`, text `#365cf5`, border `none`. Hover: `#dce6fd`.

### 3. Operational Badges & Status Chips
Badges use `micro-tag` (12px, weight 500), horizontal padding `8px`, vertical padding `2px`, height `22px`, and a pill-shaped radius (`9999px`):
- **Success (e.g., จัดส่งสำเร็จ / Fulfilled):** Background `#eaf5ef`, border `1px solid #a8dcc0`, text `#157347`.
- **Warning (e.g., รอชำระเงิน / Pending Payment):** Background `#fdf8e8`, border `1px solid #f0dc91`, text `#b08900`.
- **Error (e.g., ยกเลิกแล้ว / Cancelled):** Background `#fbecee`, border `1px solid #f4b4ba`, text `#c2333f`.
- **Neutral (e.g., แบบร่าง / Draft):** Background `#f1f4f9`, border `1px solid #d8e0eb`, text `#334155`.

### 4. Language Switcher & Environment Indicator
- **Language Switcher:** A segmented 32px pill switch in the header (`ไทย` | `English`). Active language pill uses `#ffffff` with subtle border `#e1e7f0` and `#17243b` text; inactive segment uses transparent background with `#7e8d9f` text.
- **Environment Indicator:** The `ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง` (Sample Data) chip is pinned in the contextual header. Styled with background `#fdf8e8`, border `1px solid #f0dc91`, and text `#b08900`, pairing a 6px warning dot to alert staff that non-production data is active.

### 5. Cards & Tables
- **Cards:** Background `#ffffff`, border `1px solid #e1e7f0`, border-radius `12px`, padding `20px` (or `24px` for high-level metrics).
- **Card Headers:** `title-card` (`16px`, semibold, `#17243b`), paired with an optional top-right action or badge.
- **Data Tables:** Outer border `1px solid #e1e7f0`, header row background `#f6f8fc`, header cell text `13px` medium `#52627a`, row divider `1px solid #e1e7f0`, cell height `48px`, row hover background `#f9fafc`.

### สรุปรายละเอียดการออกแบบ:
1. **โครงสร้างและเลย์เอาต์ตาม Design System:**
   - แถบเมนูด้านซ้ายขนาด 256px พร้อม 7 หมวดหมู่งานหลักของระบบพาณิชย์ไทย (สินค้าและสต็อก, ออเดอร์และการเงิน, ลูกค้าและบริการ, การตลาด, รายงานและข้อมูล, ระบบเชื่อมต่อ, ตั้งค่าและทีมงาน) และลิงก์ Developer portal
   - โทนสีมาตรฐาน: พื้นหลังแคนวาส `#f6f8fc`, การ์ดสีขาวขอบมน 12px, ขอบเขตเส้นกั้นสี `#e1e7f0`, น้ำเงินหลัก `#365cf5`, และสีสถานะความปลอดภัย/ข้อผิดพลาดตามเกณฑ์ UI องค์กร
   - ความกว้างเนื้อหากลางประมาณ 1240px รองรับการอ่านและทำงานที่สบายตา

2. **ฟังก์ชันการทำงานหลักของหน้า Dashboard:**
   - **เลือกหมวดงาน (Work Area Navigation):** การ์ดนำทางด่วน 7 หมวดหมู่งานที่สรุปตัวเลขงานค้างและสถานะ
   - **งานที่ต้องดูแล (Actionable Operational Tasks):** ตรวจสอบ Webhooks pending, Inbound webhooks failed (พร้อมการแจ้งเตือน Replay/Fix), และ Outbox backlog
   - **ข้อมูลการทำงาน (Operations KPIs):** ตัวชี้วัดสำคัญแบบเรียลไทม์ (Integrations, Customers, Products, Sync jobs 24h, Inventory levels) กำกับป้าย `ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง / Sample data`
   - **Recent sync jobs & Webhook failures:** ตารางแสดงผลสถานะการซิงก์ข้อมูลข้ามแพลตฟอร์ม (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok, POS) พร้อมสถานะ Dead-letter queue และปุ่มปฏิบัติการ

3. **ระบบ 2 ภาษา (Bilingual Support TH/EN):**
   - มีปุ่มสลับภาษา `ไทย / English` ที่มุมบนขวา สามารถกดสลับภาษาของข้อความบนหน้าจอได้ทันที
   - แนบแท็ก `<script id="commerce-ui-translations" type="application/json">` ที่มีคู่แปลภาษาครบถ้วนทุกคีย์ตาม UI Copy Catalogue ที่กำหนดสำหรับส่งต่อให้กับ React / `@cp/ui` ต่อไป
